facts.claim: Washington home inspection standard: the report describes the type(s) of branch wiring and flags potentially hazardous conductors for a licensed electrical contractor.
facts.quote: (a) Describe in the report the type and rating of primary service ... and the type(s) of branch wiring used. (d) Report, the presence of electrical conductors known to be potentially hazardous and that a licensed electrical contractor should further evaluate the types and methods of branch wiring used. WAC 308-408C-110

facts.claim: Berkeley's form #146: the electrician certifies good condition, no deterioration, proper overcurrent protection, no improper connections or splices; or not good condition; or disconnected; with state license number and class.

facts.claim: Washington RCW 48.18.2901: an insurer that will not renew must mail written notice at least 60 days before expiration, with its actual reason.
facts.quote: Each insurer must renew any insurance policy subject to RCW 48.18.290 unless one of the following situations exists: (A) The insurer must deliver or mail written notice of nonrenewal to the named insured at least 60 days before the expiration date of the policy; and (B) The notice must include the insurer's actual reason for refusing to renew the policy.

facts.claim: Washington RCW 48.18.290: cancellation needs at least 60 days written notice with the actual reason (non-payment: 10 days).
facts.quote: The insurer must deliver or mail written notice of cancellation to the named insured at least 60 days before the effective date of the cancellation; and (ii) The cancellation notice must include the insurer's actual reason for canceling the policy. If an insurer cancels a policy described under (a) or (b) of this subsection for nonpayment of premium, the insurer must deliver or mail the cancellation notice to the named insured at least 10 days before the effective date of the cancellation.
